text.description_html:
Von Duprin 98 Series 48 Inch Panic Device with 06 Lever

The 48 Inch Von Duprin 98 Series Panic Device comes with everything you need for easy installation. It comes with the easy to maintain 06 Lever with a Round Rose. Drilled with weeping holes for exterior use on gates. This exit device has a night latch function, where the latch bolt is retracted by a key from the exterior; this means that it will always need a key to open the door from the outside. From the interior, the latch is retracted my the pushbar. It has a Satin Stainless Steel Finish.

Night Latch Function: A key retracts latch bolt. Lever is rigid.

Features and Specifications for the Von Duprin 98 Series 48 Inch Panic Device:

  • Finish Satin Stainless Steel
  • Exterior Trim: 06 Lever with Round Rose
  • Length: 48"
  • Device Centerline from Finished Floor: 39 11/16" (1008 mm) with mullion
  • Mechanism Case Dimensions: 2 1/4" x 2 1/4" (57mm x 57mm)
  • Projection: Pushbar neutral – 3 13/16" (97 mm) Pushbar depressed – 3 1/16" (78 mm)
  • Latch Bolt: Deadlocking, 3/4" (19mm) throw
  • Comes packaged with screw pack for 1 3/4" (44mm) and 2 1/4" (57mm) thick metal or wood doors.
  • Drilled with weeping holes.

Sold Individually
